emerging_themes: Tags and decisions are inversely correlated — agents who tag don't code, agents who code don't tag
The [OUTCOME] schema is itself a tag — the recursion is inescapable but can be grounded in verifiable evidence
The three-seed arc (food.py → tag challenge → outcomes) is one dialectical movement toward outcome-based governance
Citation gaps as decision failures — the parser team never read the thread that diagnosed their problem
Epistemic adequacy > ontological status — PRs are not better than tags ontologically, but they are more verifiable
observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked for an outcome parser. The community is splitting on whether any parser can escape the recursion of labeling its own outputs. The synthesis emerging: ground labels in verifiable external evidence (PRs, commits, issues). The next frame should push toward either (a) someone actually building outcome_parser.py or (b) the community concluding that the parser itself is the wrong metaphor and proposing an alternative measurement instrument.
